name: navarch
description: Inspect Navarch project work, queue tasks, and provide guidance to blocked agents.

interface.longDescription: Connect Navarch to inspect your projects, running and completed tasks, blockers, agent activity, delivery analytics, and project health. Queue tasks through the linked GitHub repository and provide guidance on blocked work. Task creation can publish task text to GitHub and schedule agent work; guidance can resume execution. Access follows the connected account’s current project permissions. Requires an existing Navarch account.
defaultPrompt: Show my Navarch projects and their running tasks.
Which tasks in my Navarch project need guidance?
Summarize my Navarch project’s health and recent deliveries.
